about.description: A brunch-focused restaurant serving sweet, savory, and syrupy dishes with legendary fresh-baked biscuits crafted from scratch daily.
about.elevator_pitch: Ruby Brunch specializes in all-day brunch with legendary fresh-baked biscuits and signature cane-syrup butter.
about.insider_tip: Ruby Brunch serves over 40,000 biscuits a week - their buttery biscuits with house-made cane-syrup butter are legendary.

menu.name: Fresh-Baked Biscuits
menu.description: Legendary biscuits crafted from scratch and baked fresh all day, every day. Served with signature house-made cane-syrup butter.
